_README: Tooth formation ages (months from birth; negative = before birth) used for dental age estimation and for dating enamel hypoplasia. For each tooth: crown initiation, crown complete (Crc), root length complete (Rc) and apex closed (Ac). Ages of the Moorrees et al. (1963) stages in between are spaced evenly: Ci-Crc over the crown, Ri-Rc over the root, A1/2-Ac over apex closure. PLACEHOLDERS: rounded textbook values for both sexes together, close to widely reproduced charts but not taken from a checked table. Replace them with stage ages from a published standard (e.g. AlQahtani et al. 2010, the London Atlas; Smith 1991 for Moorrees stages) and their SDs (TBD-LAB). cuspal_months: enamel formation time hidden under the cusp, before the first perikymata reach the surface (Reid & Dean 2006); null = not yet set, taken as 0.
tbd_note: Replace the formation ages with a published dental standard (stage ages and SDs), and add cuspal formation times for the hypoplasia calculation.
